name: ICDO
title: International Classification of Diseases for Oncology (ICD-O) - 4th Edition 2026
description: The International Classification of Diseases for Oncology (ICD-O) - 4th Edition, 2026, is used principally in tumour or cancer registries for coding the site (topography) and the histology (morphology) of neoplasms, usually obtained from a pathology report. ICD-O is a multi-axial classification of the site, morphology, behaviour, and grading of neoplasms.
